description: Test configuration for kivg core image draw mode patterns
note: This demo tests the new 'draw' pattern added to ColoringAnimation class in plugins/kivg/core/image.py

layers.description: Tests the new 'draw' pattern which uses grid-based nearest-neighbor approach from sketch.py

pattern_descriptions.horizontal: Left to right, row by row from top to bottom
pattern_descriptions.vertical: Top to bottom, column by column from left to right
pattern_descriptions.draw: Grid-based approach with nearest-neighbor cell selection (like sketch.py)

test_cases.name: Test Draw Pattern with small grid
test_cases.expected: Image divided into 10x10 pixel grid cells, drawn in nearest-neighbor order

test_cases.name: Test Draw Pattern with large grid
test_cases.expected: Image divided into 50x50 pixel grid cells, fewer cells, faster animation
